recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中細胞緊密成片，核圓且偏位，染色質呈粗塊狀的車輪狀（clockface）排列，胞質嗜雙色、量中等，藍色箭頭所指為典型漿細胞，構成漿細胞聚集。
features: Sheet-like aggregate of plasma cells between adipocytes
Round, eccentrically placed nuclei with coarse clockface (cartwheel) chromatin
Moderate amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm; some perinuclear clearing
Relatively uniform mature-appearing cells without prominent nucleoli
Few residual hematopoietic cells and a small vessel at the right edge
describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section shows a dense interstitial aggregate of plasma cells between fat spaces. The cells have round, eccentric nuclei with coarse clockface chromatin and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, and appear predominantly mature without prominent nucleoli or significant pleomorphism. Residual hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell aggregate; clonality should be confirmed with CD138 and kappa/lambda studies, supporting plasma cell myeloma in this clinical context.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have central oval or bean-shaped nuclei widely spaced by clear cytoplasm ('fried egg'), without clockface chromatin or eccentric nuclei.
Reactive plasma cells are scattered or perivascular and polytypic rather than forming confluent sheets.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: This shows an accompanying CD20+ B-cell component with plasma cells sharing the same light chain.
Erythroblasts have central, very round dense nuclei with clear or scant cytoplasm and form colonies, and are E-cadherin or CD71 positive rather than CD138 positive.
